links.outcome: Model performance consistency across age, gender, and race/ethnicity subgroups
links.effect: Results demonstrate strong performance and demographic consistency across age, gender, and race/ethnicity.
links.quote: Results demonstrate strong performance and demographic consistency across age, gender, and race/ethnicity supporting the feasibility of efficient multi-condition screening from brief video responses.

unlisted_practices: Single video question multi-condition mental health screening to reduce assessment time

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal ML tool (using text and speech prosody models) to screen for mental health conditions from a single video question, assessing efficiency, demographic fairness, and willingness, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail practice.
